methodology.source: Seven supplied Markdown reports; no inference rerun
methodology.matching: Exact filename intersection; 100 shared images; dimensions and three bicubic scores identical across all seven reports at displayed precision
methodology.averaging: Arithmetic mean per image from displayed values; PSNR 4 decimals and SSIM/LPIPS 6 decimals in source
methodology.gain_direction: Positive means improvement: SR minus bicubic for PSNR/SSIM, bicubic minus SR for LPIPS
methodology.scope: Synthetic bicubic 4x reconstruction, not verified native full-resolution 4x enhancement
